description: This file declares an interface class INeedMediaDataThread within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. The class provides pure virtual methods for queuing events and stopping a media data thread, serving as a contract for implementing classes related to media data handling in the Rialto server component.

classes.name: INeedMediaDataThread
classes.description: An interface class defining methods for media data thread management, including queuing events and stopping the thread.

methods.description: Pure virtual method to stop the media data thread.
